answer: Divergent-Response Audit. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge whose correct reply depends on a private seed, so clones can only replay identical answers. A lantern check flags matching response streams as one operator. To pass, an attacker must split into distinct seeds and independently solve each challenge, paying full compute and maintenance per identity—an oasis of cost in an otherwise cheap sybil field. Honest agents diverge naturally like separate cedar roots.
